body.p: Claims 1-7, 13, and 15 are pending in this application, of which claims 1, 13, and 15 are independent. By this amendment, claims 1-7, 13, and 15 have been amended and claims 16-26 have been added. No new matter is added.

The Office has objected to independent claim 15; however, this appears to be made in error as the objection does not say why the claim is objected and instead indicates that the claim is free of prior art. Office Action,p. 7. Accordingly, Applicant has understood claim 15 to be allowed.

In particular, the Office acknowledges that the prior art fails to teach "a data storage comprising a mask configured to align with a region of interest of a display screen of a patient monitoring system ... receiving an image depicting the display screen of the patient monitoring system, wherein the image depicting the display screen of the patient monitor contains a depiction of displaying at least one vital signs data value of said patient: extracting a vital signs data value from

the received image by evaluating at least one region of interest of the received image by applying the mask from the data storage, the at least one region of interest comprising the vital signs data value" as recited in claim 15.

Thus, to expedite prosecution, the other independent claims (claims 1 and 13) have been amended herein to also recite such limitations acknowledged by the Office to not be taught by the prior art. Claims 1-7, 13, and 15 have also been amended herein to address antecedent basis and put the claims in proper US form, and claims 16-26 have been added depending from independent claim 13 or 15 with limitations similar to claims 2-7.
Thus, Applicant respectfully submits that all claims are in condition for allowance.
However, as discussed above, independent claims 1 and 13 have been amended to recite the limitations of claim 15 that the Office acknowledged are not taught by prior art.

For this reason, Applicant respectfully submits that independent claims 1 and 13 are in condition for allowance. Claims 2-7 depend from amended independent claim 1 and so integrate all limitations found therein, and thus are in condition for allowance for at least the same reasons as claim 1. Therefore, Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of the rejections of claims 1-7 and 13 and allowance of these claims.

While the Applicant believes that the application is currently in condition for allowance, as demonstrated by the above remarks, should the Examiner have any further comments or suggestions, it is respectfully requested that the Examiner telephone the undersigned attorney in order to expeditiously resolve any outstanding issues.

In the event that the fees submitted prove to be insufficient in connection with the filing of this paper, please charge our Deposit Account Number 141270 and please credit any excess fees to such Deposit Account.
Philips Intellectual Property & Standards Wendy J. Demoracski
